paccācikkhati.p: [Pati+ā+cikkha+a+ti] (kri) CL=8 (1) He responds and reply. (2) He gives up; abandoned.

DOP: paccācikkhati pr. 3 sg. [ redupl. pr. of paccakkhāti qv; BHS pratyācikṣati; cf S. pratyā√cakṣ], renounces, repudiates; refuses, repulses; Vin IV 235, 24 foll. (Caṇḍakālī bhikkhunī … kupitā anattamānā evaṃ vadeti buddhaṃ ~āmi … sikkhaṃ ~āmi); D III 3, 8 (ko santo kaṃ ~asi; Sv 817, 23 foll.: yācako vā yācitakaṃ ~eyya yācitako vā yācakaṃ tvaṃ pana n’ eva yācako na yācitako); M I 245, 16 (so kho ahaṃ … tā devatā ~āmi, halan ti vadāmi); — part.pr. paccācikkhanta, mfn. , Th-a II 173, 20 (paccakkhan ti ~anto pariccajanto); Kkh 2 32, 24 .

paccācikkhanā f. [ from paccācikkhati], renouncing; Vin V 88, 7* ( in uddāna: osāre ~ā; Sp 1310, 12 foll.: chandaṃ osāreyyā ti ca buddhaṃ paccācikkhāmī ti ca vuttasikkhāpadadvayaṃ) = Kkh 2 372, 9* ; — see also paccakkhāna.
